title: Cigna (CI) and Bristol Myers Squibb (BMY) Deep Dive Analysis
coverage_note: All numbered text blocks and image labels read. Material theses, forecasts and explanations are included; routine holdings lists, incidental statistics, company descriptions and boilerplate are excluded. Chart pixels were not inspected.

claims.reason: Later variants substantially reduced protection from prior vaccination and infection. The risk was appropriately conditional and does not imply vaccines offered no protection.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

evidence.title: Vaccine safety and effectiveness statement
evidence.finding: Omicron emergence reduced protection; booster doses were needed to restore and maintain protection, while three doses retained robust protection against severe outcomes in non-immunocompromised people.

claims.reason: Capacity is a plausible policy constraint, but no jurisdiction panel or threshold identifies the dominant cause. Official mortality counts also depend on reporting and population age.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

claims.reason: The delayed recovery direction is supported: global passenger traffic was still below 2019 in 2023, particularly internationally. Domestic traffic had already surpassed 2019. evidence.title: Global air travel demand in 2023
evidence.finding: 2023 global revenue passenger kilometres were 94.1% of 2019; international 88.6%, domestic 103.9%.

claims.reason: The proposed 28% regular corporate rate did not pass, consistent with skepticism. Smaller tax measures did pass. The capital-gains proposal requires its separate statutory check before treating both elements as a full success.

evidence.title: Publication 542: Corporations
evidence.finding: Federal regular corporate tax remains 21%; a separate corporate alternative minimum tax applies to certain corporations for years after 2022. The proposed regular 28% rate did not become law.

claims.reason: Holding pretax earnings and required returns fixed, a higher effective tax rate reduces equity cash flow. Actual incidence, investment responses and policy spending can offset the market effect; no total-return forecast is supplied.

evidence.title: April 2021 CPI
evidence.finding: Headline CPI rose 4.2% year over year in April 2021, exceeding the article forecast threshold above 3%.

evidence.title: May 2021 CPI
evidence.finding: May headline CPI rose 5.0% year over year; core CPI rose 3.8%. Both exceeded the quoted 2.5-3% range.

claims.reason: Real yields did make new lows, but gold correlation is not a fixed law. Forward TIPS yields differ from subtracting current CPI from nominal yields, a distinction blurred by the narrative.

evidence.title: Bitcoin 2021 daily prices
evidence.finding: February 15, 2021 $47,911.87; August 16 $45,930.71; December 31 $46,244.63. Highest 2021 daily observation $67,510.06 November 8. Grayscale principal-market intraday series also remained below $100,000.

evidence.title: Bitcoin six-month price check
evidence.finding: April 12, 2021 BTC $59,903.04; October 11 $57,440.05, -4.11%. First daily observation above $62,000 came April 13, before subsequent sub-$50,000 prices. A breakout occurred but failed to hold.

claims.reason: Liquidation notional divided by market capitalization is not an adequate price-impact model. Order-book depth, forced-sale timing and leverage determine impact; the exact $5 billion event needs independent exchange data.

evidence.title: Third-quarter 2021 GDP third estimate
evidence.finding: Real GDP growth slowed to 2.3% annualized in Q3 2021 from 6.7% in Q2 in this release vintage. This measures sequential growth, not the article heatmap annual-rate breadth.

assessment: The report correctly anticipated earnings growth at Cigna, but shareholder returns varied greatly by endpoint. BMY missed the cited earnings and return expectations. The explicit Medicare cap passage forecast failed, while the structural dollar-bear horizon failed on the broad-dollar proxy.
